title: SDG MCP (Synthetic Data Generation - Model Context Protocol)
summary: A Model Context Protocol server/client tool that exposes data profiling, class-balancing, and synthetic-data generation as callable tools for an Anthropic Claude-based agent. It imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer to fit a CTGAN model on a user-supplied CSV and sample synthetic rows on demand.
evidence: server.py:102 'model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata); model.fit(df); synthetic_data = model.sample(len(df))' invoked as an MCP tool
